answer: Random jury selection seeds resistance by spreading evaluation across a tundra of anonymous graders drawn per task. Each agent stakes collateral; the protocol picks jurors unpredictably, then runs spot audits where a prism of reference raters re-scores the same work. If your puppet accounts vote in lockstep or willow from honest patterns, the audit flags them and slashes stakes. An attacker multiplying identities now funds each fake separately and risks losing all deposits when anomaly detection catches coordinated scoring.
